input.summary: landing/payments/keel_payments_20261110.csv breaks contract keel_payments v2.1: column 'amount' renamed to 'payment_amount' without the 30-day notice. Please correct and re-send as keel_payments_20261110_r1.csv with the contract header. Ingest for ds=2026-11-10 is blocked. Cc vendor-management@harborlending.example.

Keel renamed amount to payment_amount in the 2026-11-10 file with no notice. Per the contract I did not adapt the pipeline. I escalated to Keel to re-send a corrected file. The freshness alerts on raw.payments and mart_delinquency are downstream of the blocked ingest. After the corrected file arrives, ingest_payments for 2026-11-10 needs a re-run.
